title: Temporary Construction Service Fee, Connection Limit and Conversion Credit — Line Extensions and New Service Construction
content:
Three figures in **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** concern temporary construction service at Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative: the flat fee for a temporary construction service, the longest a temporary service may stay connected, and the credit given against a permanent extension when a temporary service is converted to it at the same site. They carry values only on the Temporary Construction Service class.

## Figures by class

| Class of extension | Temporary service fee (flat) | Longest a temporary service may stay connected | Credit on conversion to a permanent extension at the same site |
|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | $0.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | $0.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | $0.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | $0.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Irrigation Well Extension | $0.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | $0.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Temporary Construction Service | $285.00 | 12 months | $100.00 |

## The Temporary Construction Service figures

- **Flat fee** — $285 for the temporary construction service.
- **Connection limit** — 12 months, the longest the temporary service may stay connected.
- **Conversion credit** — $100, credited against the permanent extension when the temporary service is converted to it at the same site.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical builder's temporary service is connected on a house lot and later converted to a permanent extension on that same lot; the $100 conversion credit is credited against the permanent extension. A temporary service on one lot that is not converted at that site earns no conversion credit toward an extension on a different lot.
